data.title: University of Phoenix study finds GenAI use among online adult learners associated with academic performance and technology confidence
data.description: New peer-reviewed research from the University of Phoenix challenges the assumption that students mainly utilize generative AI to compensate for academic challenges or time constraints. The study, published on Sept. 18, 2026, highlights a different perspective on the use of AI by students. The scholars at the University of Phoenix analyzed data and found that the prevailing belief may not accurately reflect the reasons behind students using generative AI. This research provides valuable insights into the motivations of students using AI in academia, with significant implications for understanding technology's role in education.

data.title: USA TrackBusway® Demonstrates Adaptable 225A Power in New T225 Installation Video
data.description: In Columbus, Ohio on September 18, 2026, USA TrackBusway® unveiled a new T225 installation video designed to guide engineers and electrical contractors in understanding how overhead power connections can be adjusted as equipment layouts evolve. data.title: EPB Launches IonQ Forte Enterprise Quantum Computer in Chattanooga
data.description: Today, EPB in Chattanooga, Tennessee, announced the opening of the EPB Quantum Center, becoming the first commercial quantum computing and networking hub in America. This launch showcases the IonQ Forte Enterprise quantum computer, marking a significant milestone in the field. The center aims to facilitate advancements in quantum computing and has established itself as a pioneer in commercial quantum technology.
